description: Remove empty directories — Deletes empty subdirectories beneath the specified path, optionally leaving the root.

_async.description: Run the command asynchronously. Returns a job id immediately.

_group.description: Assign the request to a custom stats group.

fs.description: Remote name or path to scan for empty directories.

leaveRoot.description: Set to true to preserve the top-level directory even if empty.

remote.description: Path within `fs` whose empty subdirectories should be removed.

name: operations_rmdirs
